infra.identity.title: Identity & human verification
infra.identity.text: OpenID Connect, passkeys and consent. Prove your identity or humanity through distinct verification paths, sharing only what is needed.
infra.wallet.title: Cards & digital wallets
infra.wallet.text: A personal ROUT Card, NFC verification and a public identity layer. Freeze a lost card; keep private authorisation separate.
infra.commerce.title: Commerce & creator support
infra.commerce.text: Receive support through EPC/SEPA or your own Stripe and Mollie connection. Payments go to the creator, not through ROUT.
infra.routing.title: QR, routing & analytics
infra.routing.text: Design sharp QR codes, manage dynamic destinations and follow scans with cookieless analytics and UTM tracking.
infra.eco.title: Identity. Cards. Commerce. Routing.
infra.eco.lead: A connected ecosystem — from your profile and workspace to APIs, integrations and the physical card.
infra.integrationNote: Availability depends on the integration, account and provider configuration.
infra.workspace.title: Workspaces
infra.api.title: API & Developers
infra.api.text: Open APIs, OAuth and MCP tools.
infra.lead.title: Your digital identity. Under your control.
infra.lead.text: ROUT is your sovereign digital identity: one place for your profile cards, your physical and digital pass, and secure sign-in across the web without tracking.
story.intro.kicker: More than a link in your bio.
story.intro.title: One place. A whole digital life.
story.intro.text: From the first scan to your own identity: ROUT connects your profile, links, payments, conversations and access. Not in a closed garden, but on the open web.
story.profile.title: Your place on the web. Entirely yours.
story.profile.text: Build a profile around what you choose to share: links, projects, music, video, contact and more. Your personal name, privacy alias and business workspace remain separate places, each with its own presentation and audience.
story.profile.point1.title: A profile, not a link list
story.profile.point1.text: Combine content blocks, media, connections and extra pages in a recognisable hub.
story.profile.point2.title: Choose who sees what
story.profile.point2.text: Separate professional and social connections; publish only what you want to share.
story.profile.point3.title: Your own address
story.profile.point3.text: Use your ROUT name or a configured custom domain for a recognisable destination.
story.qr.title: From a simple link to a distinctive design.
story.qr.text: Create QR codes for websites, contact details, Wi-Fi and more. Work with colours, shapes and logos, inspect the result and export for screen or print. Your browser generates the code; a saved dynamic destination needs your account.
story.qr.point1.title: Design every detail
story.qr.point1.text: Match shape, colour, logo and contrast to your brand. Keep the code readable and test before printing.
story.qr.point2.title: Static or dynamic
story.qr.point2.text: A static code contains your content; a dynamic link can point to a managed destination.
story.qr.point3.title: Ready to share
story.qr.point3.text: Export SVG, PNG or PDF and take your design to a poster, packaging or profile.
story.analytics.title: Every link has a destination. Every scan a story.
story.analytics.text: Manage short links and QR destinations from ROUT. Use campaign parameters and cookieless analytics to understand where visitors come from, without building an advertising profile of them.
story.analytics.point1.title: Short, recognisable links
story.analytics.point1.text: Create a readable address for your name, campaign or project.
story.analytics.point2.title: Campaigns with context
story.analytics.point2.text: Use UTM parameters to distinguish sources and campaigns.
story.analytics.point3.title: Measure without tracking cookies
story.analytics.point3.text: View available click and scan statistics; the chart here is illustrative, not live account data.
story.identity.title: Your identity is more than a sign-in button.
story.identity.text: Let connected apps request only what they need. ROUT ID uses OpenID Connect, passkeys and consent. Human verification and verification of your public identity are distinct signals — not the same promise.
story.identity.point1.title: Consent for each app
story.identity.point1.text: Review what an app requests before granting access and keep connections under control.
story.identity.point2.title: Human ≠ identity
story.identity.point2.text: A human signal does not automatically prove a public name; each badge has its own meaning.
story.identity.point3.title: Open standards
story.identity.point3.text: OpenID Connect and PKCE make the connection inspectable for developers.
story.wallet.title: Your digital world. Now in your hand.
story.wallet.text: Take your public profile with you as a card, QR or Wallet pass. Profile cards and access passes serve different purposes; private authorisation must never appear in public card artwork.
story.wallet.point1.title: Physical and digital
story.wallet.point1.text: Connect your public ROUT profile to your card, QR and supported Wallet presentation.
story.wallet.point2.title: Your card, your presentation
story.wallet.point2.text: The card follows ROUT’s existing public card design and your chosen information.
story.wallet.point3.title: Clear boundaries
story.wallet.point3.text: Apple and Google issuance needs configuration; revocation and lost cards follow account settings.
story.commerce.title: Give your audience a way to give back.
story.commerce.text: A support page for your work, project or initiative. EPC/SEPA provides a payment QR and IBAN; optionally connect your own Stripe or Mollie account. ROUT is not an intermediary account: payment goes to the recipient.
story.commerce.point1.title: Directly to you
story.commerce.point1.text: The recipient uses their own bank account or payment provider; ROUT does not hold the money.
story.commerce.point2.title: Verification before activation
story.commerce.point2.text: Support pages require a verified account and correct account-holder information.
story.commerce.point3.title: Part of your profile
story.commerce.point3.text: Share a dedicated support link or connect the page to your ROUT profile.
story.social.title: More room for real conversations.
story.social.text: Let visitors ask questions without showing the recipient a sender name. Choose your audience, what you answer and what you publish. Share answers as story cards; optional Ghost Mode helps with phrasing, without guaranteeing anonymity.
story.social.point1.title: Receiving is a choice
story.social.point1.text: Enable questions for everyone, members or verified members within the applicable safety boundaries.
story.social.point2.title: Publishing stays with you
story.social.point2.text: A received question is not automatically public. You decide whether to share an answer.
story.social.point3.title: Assistance, not an automatic voice
story.social.point3.text: Review and edit a Ghost Mode suggestion before sending it yourself.
story.workspace.title: For one creator. Or a whole team.
story.workspace.text: Give a business, collective or agency its own ROUT space. Manage profiles, team access, domains and campaigns in the right workspace, separate from your personal identity.
story.workspace.point1.title: Separate spaces
story.workspace.point1.text: Personal profiles and workspaces keep their own content and settings.
story.workspace.point2.title: Team access with boundaries
story.workspace.point2.text: Roles and scopes determine access; styling never grants additional rights.
story.workspace.point3.title: A recognisable brand address
story.workspace.point3.text: Connect a custom domain through the available domain and verification settings.
story.developer.title: Open protocols. New possibilities.
story.developer.text: Build with ROUT’s documented APIs, OAuth and MCP tools. Integrate identity and ROUT features with explicit consent; public documentation never grants access to private data.
story.developer.point1.title: Sign in with ROUT
story.developer.point1.text: Use OIDC discovery and the PKCE flow, and verify tokens in your own app.
story.developer.point2.title: APIs & webhooks
story.developer.point2.text: Connect supported features through documented access and account configuration.
story.developer.point3.title: Agents with bounded access
story.developer.point3.text: MCP is a tool, not a blank cheque: scopes and consent remain in control.
story.connections.title: Your favourite services. No isolated islands.
story.connections.text: Music, video, social accounts, wallets, payments and open standards find a place within ROUT. Every connection keeps its own consent and visibility.
story.more.title: Small details. Big possibilities.
story.booking.title: Bookings
story.booking.text: Let visitors choose a time within your availability and manage bookings from your agenda.
story.design.title: Design Studio
story.design.text: Tune typography, colours, backgrounds and Liquid Glass for your profile. Work on a draft before publishing.
story.guestbook.title: Guestbook
story.guestbook.text: Receive messages from verified members. Manage and pin what appears on your public profile.
story.assets.title: Files & exports
story.assets.text: Manage QR designs and files in one place; uploads follow account and retention policies.
story.security.title: Account security
story.security.text: Passkeys, two-step verification and additional confirmation for sensitive changes, where configured.
story.open.title: Open source
story.open.text: Inspect the source and AGPL licence. Control also means understanding a feature’s boundaries.
story.final.title: Your name. Your network. Your ROUT.
story.final.text: Start with a profile. Grow into the capabilities you need without handing over your digital identity.
story.social.question: What inspires you to keep creating?
story.social.answer: The people who find value in my work. Every conversation brings a new idea.
story.everyday.alt: Illustrative photograph of a visitor scanning a QR code in a coffee bar
story.everyday.kicker: From the screen to the real world
story.everyday.title: One scan. A new connection.
story.uses.kicker: ROUT / WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
story.uses.title: Link in bio, footer socials, developer login — and AI agents.
story.uses.linkbio.title: Link in bio
story.uses.linkbio.text: One designed profile hub for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and Bluesky: all your links, socials, contact and booking. Free, European and open source.
story.uses.footer.title: Social links for your website footer
story.uses.footer.text: Link your footer to one ROUT page. It lists every social account and stays up to date without touching your site.
story.uses.login.title: Login for developers
story.uses.login.text: "Login with ROUT" is a standard OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect provider with private e-mail relays and pairwise IDs.
story.uses.agents.title: Built by AI agents
story.uses.agents.text: AI agents can create a workspace on ROUT themselves, design its link-in-bio hub and prepare Login with ROUT — without an account. You claim it with a code.
story.agents.title: Create a ROUT workspace in four steps
story.agents.s1: Connect to the MCP server https://rout.be/api/mcp (no login), or use the REST API in /.well-known/rout-agent.json.
story.agents.s2: Get a sandbox key: rout_sandbox_challenge, solve the proof-of-work, then rout_sandbox_register.
story.agents.s3: Create the workspace with rout_sandbox_create_workspace and design it with rout_sandbox_design_profile (links, socials, contact).
story.agents.s4: Give your human the claim code. They sign in at rout.be, open the gear next to their workspace and choose Claim workspace.
